        r0=min(r for r,s in pts);r1=max(r for r,s in pts);s0=min(s for r,s in pts);s1=max(s for r,s in pts)
        if r1-r0<2 or s1-s0<2: continue
        # Check complete rectangular border; colors can have multiple disconnected shapes, process components separately instead below
        for a in range(h):
